SUMMARY: 🏓 Pickleball Social – All Levels Welcome! Make New Friends with Zhen !
DESCRIPTION:
Denver Fun Young Adults 20s to 40s
Ready to swap the couch for the court and make some awesome new friends?
Whether you’re a total beginner who just bought a paddle, an intermediate looking for a regular crew, or a seasoned expert ready to show off your spin, **this is your spot.**

we’re gathering for casual, social, and fun pickleball. No pressure, no judgment—just good vibes and great games.

\#\#\# 📍 Where to Find Us

* **Location:** Southpark Pickleball Complex
* we usually meet on courts 18 and 19
* **Address:** 400 W County Line Road, Highlands Ranch, CO 80129 *(Easy to find on GPS)*
* **Exact Spot:** Look for Zhen and a group of friendly people holding paddles near the courts or under the shade structures! Read comments to see what courts we are on.
* Text Zhen @ +19706319482 if you have any questions

\#\#\# 🕒 When

* Come when you can, leave when you must.

\#\#\# 👟 What to Expect

* **19 Outdoor Courts:** Plenty of space to play. Courts 18 & 19 are drop-in play, stack paddle play
* **All Skill Levels Welcome:** We love mixing beginners and intermediates to keep it social, but we can also set up competitive games for the experts.
* **Open Rotation:** We’ll rotate players after games so everyone gets a chance to play and meet new people.
* **First-Come, First-Served:** The courts are public and unreserved, so flexibility is the name of the game!

\#\#\# 🎒 What to Bring

* [ ] **Your Paddle** (If you don't have one, message us—someone might have a spare! I usually have a spare)
* [ ] **Water / Hydration**
* [ ] **Sunscreen & Hat** (Safety first!)
* [ ] **A Good Attitude**
* [ ] **Snacks to Share with Friends and Socialize**

\> **⚠️ Quick Note:** There’s no official court sign-up needed—just show up! However, **please RSVP here** so we can track rough numbers and know how many courts to claim.

Got questions? Drop a comment or message Zhen directly. See you on the courts! 🏓☀️

SUMMARY: Running Group - Belleview Elementary School and Cherry Creek State Park
DESCRIPTION:
Denver Fun Young Adults 20s to 40s
**When and where**
We **leave** the Belleview Elementary School parking lot at **5:45 PM**, so please try to arrive a few minutes before then. If you are running late or can't find us, leave a comment or send a DM!

**Pace and distance**
Our typical run is around 4.5 miles at a steady 9-11:00 minute/mile pace. However, this varies depending on who shows up!

**Group size**
We usually have around 5-10 people attend, depending on the weather and season. Many of us have been coming for years; some people come every week, while others come less frequently.

**About us**
This is a small, dedicated running group that's been meeting consistently for several years (formerly under Colorado Runs). We're a friendly, tight-knit group that welcomes new members who are looking to make friends, train for races, or find consistent running partners.

Come join us if this sounds like a good fit for your running goals! We look forward to meeting you!

SUMMARY: Stampede Ladies Night – Country Dancing & Free Drinks! 🤠💃
DESCRIPTION:
Denver Fun Young Adults 20s to 40s
**Social Country Dancing at Stampede – Ladies Night Special!**
Join the Denver Fun Young Adults crew (20s–40s) for a fun Wednesday night of country line dancing, partner dancing, and great vibes at the iconic Stampede Club!

**Event Highlights**:

* **Ladies Night perks** — Ladies get **2 free drinks** with entry!
* **Free dance lessons** — Line dancing starts at 6:30 PM (with instructor Laurie Burkhardt or similar—beginner-friendly!).
* **Social dancing** — The floor heats up around 7:30–8 PM and goes late. I usually arrive around 8 PM or later to jump straight into the social part—perfect if you're not doing lessons.
* **Music & Vibe** — Live country DJ, huge dance floor, mechanical bull, multiple bars, and a mix of line dancing + two-step/partner dancing. Casual, energetic, and welcoming to all levels.
* **Food & Extras** — Grill menu available (burgers, wings, etc.) if you get hungry.

**Details**:

* **Date**: Every Wednesday (I'll probably do once a month)
* **Time**: Doors open at 6:00 PM \| Lessons 6:30–7:30 PM \| Social dancing \~8 PM onward

(I show up around 8:30-9 pm because that's when it gets busy, and I have a small group beforehand)

* **Location**: Stampede Club 2430 South Havana St., Aurora, CO 80014 (About 30–45 min drive from Castle Rock/Denver—free parking lot!)
* **Cover**: $10 (often discounted or waived for ladies on specials—check door)
* **Meetup Spot**: I'll try to gather by the tables close to the front of the Ladies/Men restrooms (right when you walk inside and enter the dance floor, I'm most likely to be dancing)

**Tips for Newbies**:

* Dress: Country casual (boots encouraged, jeans/comfy shoes for dancing)
* Age: 21+ with valid ID
* Bring: Comfortable dance shoes (no rubber soles), friends, and your energy!
* First time? Arrive early for lessons or later like me—no pressure!

RSVP so we can spot you in the crowd! Tag friends who love country vibes or want to try line dancing. Let's boot-scoot and mingle! 🤠🕺

Questions? Comment below or DM me. See you on the dance floor!
#DenverCountryDancing #StampedeLadiesNight #LineDancingDenver #DenverYoungAdults #CountryNightOut #DenverFun

Denver Fun Young Adults 20s to 40s
☕ End the week somewhere better than your kitchen table.
Every Friday we take over a corner of a local coffee shop, grab a good drink, and get real work done side by side. Bring your laptop, your to-do list, or the project you keep promising yourself you'll finish. 💻 Remote workers, freelancers, founders, grad students, and anyone with a flexible Friday are welcome.

🛠️ HOW IT WORKS
☕ Arrive, order something, and say hi
🎧 Please respect anyone with headphones on and keep interruptions to a minimum.
🎯 Optional: share one thing you want to finish today, then check in on it before you leave

🙌 WHY COME
Working alone all week gets old. A little shared focus makes the hours go faster, and the conversations on breaks tend to be the good kind: what people are building, where they're hiking this weekend, what they're reading, what they're working through. 📚🥾
It's also the easiest way to meet the group if you haven't made it to a hike or pickleball night yet. No need to be "on." Show up, do your thing, and connect when it feels natural. 🤝

💬 Our WhatsApp community is invite-only, and invites happen in person. Come say hi and ask your organizer to add you!

📝 A FEW NOTES
🧾 Please buy something. The shop is sharing its space with us, so let's be great guests.
🎧 Please respect anyone with headphones on and keep interruptions to a minimum.
🚪 Come and go as your day needs. Stay for an hour or the whole session.
🚫 This is coworking, not networking. Leave the pitch and the business cards at home and just get to know people.
📞 Take calls outside so everyone else can stay focused.

🏔️ Lots of us head into the weekend with plans to get outside, so if you're looking for a trail or ski buddy for Saturday, this is a good place to find one. ⛷️ See you Friday! ☕✨

Denver Fun Young Adults 20s to 40s
**Why work alone when we can hustle together?** 🚀

**✨ We create the space — you bring the energy!** Come solo or bring friends, and get ready to focus, connect, and get things done! 💻🙌

**💻 Join us every Friday and finish the week strong!** Whether you're working remotely, studying, job hunting, or tackling a personal project, let's stay motivated, productive, and accountable together!

**🎉 HUSTLE HARD, HUDDLE A LITTLE!**
Need a brain break? Grab coffee or breakfast, socialize, stretch your legs by the patio fire pit, or challenge someone to cornhole! ☕🔥🎯

📍 **Meeting Spot:** Find us at a communal table near the coffee bar! 💻

💻 **Bring:** Laptop, charger, and headphones. Please purchase a drink or bite to support our venue!

⏰ **Drop in anytime!** Work at your own pace.

🚗 **Parking:** Street parking nearby. Check posted signs for restrictions or fees.

👥 **Limited spots!** Plans change? We get it! Please update your RSVP early. **Reliable RSVPs get priority!** 😊
